item: 1a. Hanuman 10 (Thailand, 80 MW) — in GEM but dropped as a duplicate of the curated “Subyai (Chaiyaphum)”; position from ADB turbine table
proposal:
GEM_KEEP[('THA', 'Hanuman 10 wind farm')] = ('Energy Absolute 的 Hanuman 10（Banchuan Development 公司，80 MW、32 部西門子歌美颯 2.5 MW，猜也蓬府 Bamnet Narong 縣 Ban Chuan 分區，2019-04-13 商轉）與 EGCO 2016 年的 Chaiyaphum 風場（Subyai，Sap Yai 縣）是兩座；舊建置把它當成「Subyai (Chaiyaphum)」的重複刪掉', 'Energy Absolute’s Hanuman 10 (Banchuan Development Co, 80 MW, 32 Siemens Gamesa 2.5 MW, Ban Chuan subdistrict, Bamnet Narong district, Chaiyaphum; COD 13 Apr 2019) is not EGCO’s 2016 Chaiyaphum Wind Farm (Subyai, Sap Yai district); the old build dropped it as a duplicate of “Subyai (Chaiyaphum)”', 'https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/53255/53255-001-esmr-en_9.pdf')

It has 32 Siemens Gamesa 2.5 MW turbines (153 m hub, 126 m rotor)', 'https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/53255/53255-001-esmr-en_9.pdf', lat=15.536, lon=101.557, turbine='32x Siemens Gamesa 2.5 MW')
note_zh: Hanuman 10 其實在 GEM 2026-02 裡（「Hanuman 10 wind farm」，80 MW、2019、Energy Absolute，Ban Chuan 分區、Bamnet Narong 縣的概略點 15.5382°N、101.5644°E），但 build_farms.log 有「DROP THA operating Hanuman 10 wind farm 80.0 ~ Subyai (Chaiyaphum) 90.0」：建置把它當成精選 Subyai 的重複刪掉了。兩者是不同風場：EGCO 的 Chaiyaphum 風場在 Sap Yai（Subyai）縣，Hanuman 10 在 Bamnet Narong 縣 Ban Chuan 分區（ADB 表 1）。ADB 報告表 2 有 Hanuman 1、5、8、9、10 共 103 部風機的度分秒座標；Hanuman 10 的 32 點平均為 15.5356°N、101.5570°E。OpenStreetMap 沒有 Hanuman 10 的風機（101.49–101.60°E、15.49–15.63°N 範圍內只有 EGCO 的 32 部）。補回需要 GEM_KEEP 加 fix 兩條；GEM_KEEP 也會讓 coverage_report 不把它與 Subyai 列為疑似重複。
note_en: Hanuman 10 is in fact in GEM 2026-02 (“Hanuman 10 wind farm”, 80 MW, 2019, Energy Absolute, approximate point 15.5382 N, 101.5644 E in Ban Chuan subdistrict, Bamnet Narong district), but build_farms.log shows “DROP THA operating Hanuman 10 wind farm 80.0 ~ Subyai (Chaiyaphum) 90.0”: the build dropped it as a duplicate of the curated Subyai record. They are different farms: EGCO’s Chaiyaphum Wind Farm is in Sap Yai (Subyai) district, Hanuman 10 in Ban Chuan subdistrict, Bamnet Narong district (ADB Table 1). Table 2 of the ADB report gives DMS coordinates for all 103 turbines of Hanuman 1, 5, 8, 9 and 10; the mean of Hanuman 10’s 32 points is 15.5356 N, 101.5570 E. OpenStreetMap has no Hanuman 10 turbines (only EGCO’s 32 in 101.49–101.60 E, 15.49–15.63 N). Restoring it needs both rules (GEM_KEEP + fix); GEM_KEEP also keeps coverage_report from listing it with Subyai as a suspected duplicate.
why: Settled: the ADB table is an EA-prepared monitoring report published by ADB, and its Hanuman 1/8 and 5/9 rows match the OpenStreetMap turbines to within 16 m and 45 m (see 1b), which confirms the table. The 36-node unnamed OSM cluster (IDs 13920198822–61) is Hanuman 1 + 8 (18 + 18), not Hanuman 10.

item: 1c. Subyai (Chaiyaphum) = EGCO’s Chaiyaphum Wind Farm — position from its OSM wind-farm relation
proposal: edit the existing rule (farm_cleanup.py, the Thailand block) to: fix('THA', 'Subyai (Chaiyaphum)', C, 'EGCO 的 Chaiyaphum 風場：位於猜也蓬府 Subyai（Sap Yai）縣，80 MW（32 × 2.5 MW），2016-12-16 商轉；業主名稱原本拼錯。點位改為 OpenStreetMap 風場關係「Chaiyaphum Wind Farm」（16162037，業主 EGCO Group、80 MW、2016）32 部風機的平均（北緯 15.603°、東經 101.538°；原點在南南東約 7 km，落在 Hanuman 10 的範圍）', 'EGCO’s Chaiyaphum Wind Farm: in Subyai (Sap Yai) district, Chaiyaphum, 80 MW (32 × 2.5 MW), commercial operation from 16 Dec 2016; the owner name was misspelt. The point moves to the mean of the 32 turbines of the OpenStreetMap wind-farm relation “Chaiyaphum Wind Farm” (16162037; owner EGCO Group, 80 MW, 2016): 15.603 N, 101.538 E (the old point was about 7 km SSE, inside Hanuman 10)', 'https://www.egco.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/124/egco-group-starts-commercial-operation-of-its-latest-chaiyaphum-wind-farm', mw=80, owner='EGCO', lat=15.603, lon=101.538, turbine='32x 2.5 MW')
note_zh: 精選的 Subyai 點（15.54°N、101.56°E）落在 Hanuman 10 的風機中間（ADB），這也是舊建置把 GEM 的 Hanuman 10 併進來的原因。OSM 關係 16162037「Chaiyaphum Wind Farm」（owner=EGCO Group、80 MW、start_date 2016）有 32 部風機與一座變電所（way 1194934619「Chaiyaphum Wind Farm Substation」），風機平均 15.6026°N、101.5384°E，在 Sap Yai 縣（與 EGCO 新聞稿的 Subyai 縣相符）；GEM 的「Chaiyaphum (EGCO) wind farm」（別名 Subyai Wind Power Project）精確點 15.5992°N、101.5087°E 正是這群最西端的一部。機型：OSM 標 Goldwind GW121，新華社也寫金風，但 Power Technology 寫 GE，互相矛盾，所以只寫「32x 2.5 MW」。原規則的出處是 Bangkok Post；改用 EGCO 官方新聞稿（同樣寫 80 MW、32 部 2.5 MW、Subyai 縣、2016-12-16 商轉），也可以保留 Bangkok Post。
note_en: The curated Subyai point (15.54 N, 101.56 E) sits among Hanuman 10’s turbines (ADB), which is why the old build merged GEM’s Hanuman 10 into it. OSM relation 16162037 “Chaiyaphum Wind Farm” (owner=EGCO Group, 80 MW, start_date 2016) has 32 turbines and a substation (way 1194934619, “Chaiyaphum Wind Farm Substation”); the turbine mean is 15.6026 N, 101.5384 E, in Sap Yai district (matching EGCO’s “Subyai district”); GEM’s “Chaiyaphum (EGCO) wind farm” (other name Subyai Wind Power Project) has an exact point, 15.5992 N, 101.5087 E, at the westernmost of these turbines. Model: OSM tags Goldwind GW121 and Xinhua says Goldwind, but Power Technology says GE, so only “32x 2.5 MW” is written. The rule’s current source is the Bangkok Post; the EGCO press release (same 80 MW, 32 × 2.5 MW, Subyai district, COD 16 Dec 2016) is proposed instead, though the Bangkok Post link can stay.
why: OSM relation with name and owner tags matching the farm, plus the owner’s press release for district and capacity. The centroid was computed from the relation’s 32 member nodes (api.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6/relation/16162037/full; XML tag attributes are not visible to check_quotes, so the relation and a member node page are quoted instead).

item: 2. TDC’s Lạc Hòa 1 (Sóc Trăng wind farm No. 5, 30 MW) — coordinates and the last 5 MW
proposal: (missing, no change) Lạc Hòa 1 / Sóc Trăng wind farm No. 5 — Vinh Chau–TDC Renewable Energy JSC; coastal flats of Lạc Hòa commune and ward 2, Vĩnh Châu (now Cần Thơ); 30 MW, 6 × 5 MW; 25 MW at COD by 31 Oct 2021, the other 5 MW still “COD dossier not submitted” on 30 Apr 2025. Still no citable coordinates.
note_zh: 仍沒有可引用的座標。新試的路線：(1) OSM API 永珠一帶（105.93–106.20°E、9.26–9.44°N）沒有任何具名的風場、風機或升壓站，只有「Trạm Biến áp 110 kV Vĩnh Châu」；沿海岸有一串 5 部無名風機（9.312–9.331°N、106.021–106.078°E，changeset 179786102，註解只寫「Update」），位置與「樂和社與第 2 坊的海岸灘地」相符，但沒有名稱或業主，不能單獨引用。(2) OpenInfraMap 的越南電廠清單裡沒有這座。(3) GEM 2026-02 也沒有（GEM 的「Lạc Hòa wind farm」一期是 UPC／AC Energy 的和東社那座；「Sóc Trăng 4」是 4 號）。(4) thewindpower.net 的永珠條目註明「Precise localization: No」。最後 5 MW：EVN 2025-04-30 表仍是「未送 COD 文件」，之後沒找到新的追蹤表或公告。
note_en: Still no citable coordinates. New routes tried: (1) the OSM API around Vĩnh Châu (105.93–106.20 E, 9.26–9.44 N) has no named wind farm, turbine or substation except “Trạm Biến áp 110 kV Vĩnh Châu”; a string of 5 unnamed turbines along the shore (9.312–9.331 N, 106.021–106.078 E, changeset 179786102, comment just “Update”) fits “the coastal flats of Lạc Hòa commune and ward 2”, but without a name or operator it cannot be cited on its own. (2) OpenInfraMap’s list of Vietnamese plants does not have it. (3) Nor does GEM 2026-02 (GEM’s “Lạc Hòa wind farm” phase 1 is UPC / AC Energy’s plant in Hòa Đông; “Sóc Trăng 4” is No. 4). (4) thewindpower.net’s Vĩnh Châu entry says “Precise localization: No”. The last 5 MW: EVN’s 30 Apr 2025 tracker still says “COD dossier not submitted”; no later tracker or announcement found.
why: No named OSM feature, no provincial sea-area decision with coordinates found (search returned only other investors’ decisions), no newer EVN tracker located. If someone adds name/operator tags to the 5 shore turbines in OSM, they could be used.

note_zh: 這筆 GEM 紀錄混了兩件事：GEM 頁面的名稱、50 MW 與狀態出處（工貿部 1509 號決定）都是薄遼東海 1 號第 4 期；別名「V1-4 - Dong Hai (intertidal)」、點位 9.5144°N、106.3910°E 與業主 SC-CCG 則只引 4C Offshore 的舊頁（不能用）。茶榮的 V1-4 場址就是 REE 的 Duyên Hải（V1-4）48 MW，已由第十二輪規則改成「Duyên Hai wind farm · 1」運轉中；這筆若當成茶榮 V1-4 就是重複，所以改指薄遼（今金甌）東海 1 號第 4 期。第 4 期 2026-08-28 啟動、投資人已定（Miền Tây 風電），但越通社說啟動後才做勘察、可研與用地手續，所以列「規劃中（st=2）」而不是興建中。點位：東海 1 號（Bắc Phương，100 MW）在原東海縣 Long Điền Đông 社（Báo Đấu thầu），新各期在東海社、隆田社的海域（越通社）；找不到可引用的風機座標，只能暫用 GEM 第 1–2 期的概略點並標概略（見 3d：那個點本身也可疑）。
note_en: This GEM record mixes two things: the name on GEM’s page, the 50 MW and the status source (MOIT Decision 1509) are all Bạc Liêu’s Dong Hai 1 phase 4, while the alias “V1-4 - Dong Hai (intertidal)”, the point 9.5144 N, 106.3910 E and the owner SC-CCG cite only an old 4C Offshore page (not usable). Trà Vinh’s V1-4 site is REE’s Duyen Hai (V1-4), 48 MW, already turned into the operating “Duyên Hai wind farm · 1” by a round-12 rule; read as Trà Vinh V1-4 this record would be a duplicate, so it is repointed to Dong Hai 1 phase 4 in Bạc Liêu (now Cà Mau). Phase 4 was launched on 28 Aug 2026 with its investor chosen (Mien Tay Wind Power), but VietnamPlus says surveys, the feasibility study and land procedures come after the launch, so pre-construction (st=2) rather than construction. Position: Dong Hai 1 (Bắc Phương, 100 MW) is in Long Điền Đông commune of the former Đông Hải district (Báo Đấu thầu), and the new phases in the sea off Đông Hải and Long Điền communes (VietnamPlus); with no citable turbine position, the approximate point of GEM’s phases 1–2 is the only placeholder (flagged approximate; see 3d, that point is itself doubtful).
why: Identity, owner, status and year are sourced; the position is only a placeholder (approx=True). If the main session prefers not to reuse a doubtful point, drop lat/lon/approx from the rule (the record then stays at GEM’s Trà Vinh point, ~98 km off).

note_zh: GEM 的東海 1 號（L100000901390）有三期：第 1、2 期各 50 MW（2021、2022，Bắc Phương，概略點 9.101°N、105.601°E），第 3 期 50 MW「announced」、沒有業主、概略點 9.3523°N、109.1463°E（只引 4C Offshore 的舊頁），那個點在南海中央。工貿部 1509 號決定的薄遼省表列有「Đông Hải 1 - giai đoạn 3」50 MW；越通社 2026-08 說投資人是 Bắc Phương 風能股份公司（Công ty cổ phần Năng lượng gió Bắc Phương，與 GEM 第 1–2 期的業主 Bac Phuong Energy JSC 名稱不同）。點位問題同 3a。
note_en: GEM’s Dong Hai 1 (L100000901390) has three phases: phases 1 and 2, 50 MW each (2021, 2022, Bắc Phương, approximate point 9.101 N, 105.601 E), and phase 3, 50 MW, “announced”, no owner, approximate point 9.3523 N, 109.1463 E (citing only an old 4C Offshore page) in the middle of the South China Sea. why: Identity, owner, status and year are sourced; GEM’s point is clearly wrong (about 390 km out in the South China Sea); the replacement is a flagged placeholder.
